nodes.name: Update policies.is_frozen
nodes.notes: NOTE: this node targets the single existing policies row. In n8n, set 'id' filter to the known wallet row id (see setup-guide.md step 4) rather than hardcoding a value here.

nodes.name: Insert Audit Log Row
nodes.notes: Writes recipient='SYSTEM', amount=0, status='FROZEN'/'UNFROZEN', reason='actor: <actor> — <reason>'. See decisions.md ADR-005.

meta.description: Freezes/unfreezes the wallet by writing policies.is_frozen and logs an auditable SYSTEM event into transaction_logs. This is the ONLY workflow allowed to change is_frozen.
